Alex Chen: Heads-up — prospective FinServ customer requested 13 months of SIEM retention + admin activity audit trails (console + API + role changes). They specifically asked for SIG/CAIQ evidence for logging controls. Can we produce a POC artifact (sample export + ingest config) they can drop into their vendor review? @Maria @Samir
Maria Lopez: We can. Default hosted retention is 90d, but Dedicated/Private customers can archive logs to customer-managed S3 for longer retention. For SIG/CAIQ we normally provide: a) sample audit export (JSONL), b) retention policy doc showing lifecycle rules, c) description of what events are captured (UI/login/API/key rotation/role assignment). Need to confirm: data residency (EU) + contract amendment for extended retention.
Samir Patel: For the POC I can produce a 7-day sample export with two ingest formats: Splunk HEC (HTTP Event Collector) and raw JSONL to S3. Minimal command example:
```
redwood export-audit --org-id org_12345 --start 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z --end 2026-12-08T00:00:00Z --format jsonl --dest s3://redwood-poc-exports/finserv/ --kms arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:1111:key/abcd
```
Sample JSON schema (trimmed):
```
{
  "ts":"2026-12-01T12:34:56Z",
  "event_type":"admin.ui.update_role",
  "actor":{ "id":"user_789","email":"eng@cust.com" },
  "target":{ "type":"role","id":"role_admin" },
  "ip":"1.2.3.4",
  "request_id":"req_abc123"
}
```
Kayla Thompson: One ask from sales: can we also include a short Splunk HEC example stanza and a Datadog ingest snippet so the customer's SecOps can spin it up quickly? Customer wants to validate SIEM acceptance within their 2-week PoC window.
Maria Lopez: Yes. We'll include both. Note: admin activity includes UI actions, API keys, service principals, SSO/SCIM provisioning events, and role/policy changes. All events include immutable IDs and request IDs; logs are signed and stored encrypted at rest using customer KMS when using Dedicated/Private export.
Alex Chen: Great — what about cost impact on pricing? Extended 13-month retention will increase storage/ingest costs. Ballpark for the POC (7 days) is negligible, but we should add a note: long-term retention on customer S3 means storage billed at S3 rates + minimal Redwood export fee (~$0.01/GB/month as an internal guideline). I'll confirm exact numbers with finance if they push.
Samir Patel: For the Splunk stanza, send them this example (send raw HTTP to HEC):
```
curl -k -H 'Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>' \
  https://splunk.example.com:8088/services/collector/event \
  -d '{"event": <json_event_here>, "sourcetype":"redwood:audit"}'
```
For Datadog we recommend using JSONL over HTTPS via our export-to-http connector; we will attach the connector config.
OpsBot: Shared artifact: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Sec/pages/123456789/Audit+Export+Samples :paperclip: (includes sample exports, retention policy template, and CAIQ mapping spreadsheet).
Kayla Thompson: Plan: Samir to run export tomorrow -> Maria to append retention + controls doc -> I draft customer email and attach artifacts. Can everyone confirm availability tomorrow morning PST? I need to tell the customer ETA.
Maria Lopez: Confirmed. I will also add a short statement on proof of immutability and KMS key rotation logs (we keep key rotation audit entries via CloudTrail for Private deployments).
Samir Patel: Confirmed — I have access to the customer's trial org. I just need the exact org-id and the 7-day window. I can produce both JSONL and a Splunk HEC payload.
Alex Chen: I'll get the org-id and ask the customer if EU data residency required. Kayla, cc me on the outbound.
Kayla Thompson: Will do. Draft email ready by EOD PST and I'll send once artifacts land. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Awesome — thanks team. If legal needs to touch retention terms we can pause commerce but still deliver the POC export under our standard NDA.
Maria Lopez: Noted. If they require formal evidence for SIG mapping we may hand over the CAIQ mapping spreadsheet (redacted) + sample logs. OK to share with customer under NDA.
Samir Patel: I'll upload the sample export to the Confluence page and also put a presigned S3 link in the customer email (expires in 7 days).
Kayla Thompson: Perfect. Moving to action items: Samir (export), Maria (controls doc + CAIQ notes), Alex (org/residency + pricing heads-up). Back here after artifacts are uploaded.
Alex Chen: Thanks — closing loop tomorrow.
